# orchestration_cluster_mapping_rule (Data Source)

Looks up a mapping rule inside a Camunda cluster by ID. See the Camunda documentation on [mapping rules](https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/admin/mapping-rules/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orchestration_cluster_mapping_rule" "admin" {
  mapping_rule_id = "admin-mapping"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mapping_rule_id` (String) The unique ID of the mapping rule to look up.

### Read-Only

- `claim_name` (String) The name of the claim to map.
- `claim_value` (String) The value of the claim to map.
- `name` (String) The name of the mapping rule.
